back_text: 支持大型讲座录播，但认为还须保留讨论、提问和应用机会。

She recommends collecting another term of data and adjusting the timetable gradually, rather than treating the forecast as a guaranteed outcome.

back_text: 若晚课增加，晚间公交需求可能上升，但应继续收集数据、逐步调整。

She points out that extra capacity will not solve confusion about ownership or retention periods. Once those rules are clear, the organisation can estimate how much additional storage it actually needs.

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 顾问认为平均数差异值得研究，但应同时看数据分布。individual results overlap 表示两组个体结果有重叠，所以不能仅凭均值给每个人排出绝对高低。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 averages 与 individual results 的区别。

audio.transcript: The statistical adviser says the difference between the two averages is worth examining, but it should not be interpreted on its own. The groups vary in size, and individual results overlap substantially. She recommends looking at the spread of the data before claiming that every member of one group performs better than every member of the other.

back_text: 两组规模不同，个人结果也有大量重叠；平均数的差异不能说明一组每个人都比另一组所有人好。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 自动检查能发现重复词和部分拼写错误，但未必理解作者想说什么，也未必能判断例子是否支持论点。因此应先用工具检查，再细读和讨论。
analysis.exam_tip: 记工具擅长的表面问题，再记需要人理解的论证问题。

audio.transcript: The writing adviser finds automatic checks useful for spotting repeated words and some spelling errors. Yet she argues that a tool may not understand what a student intends to say or whether an example supports the argument. She therefore recommends using the checks as a first step, followed by careful reading and discussion.

back_text: 工具能查部分表面问题，却未必理解意图和论据关系，仍需阅读与讨论。

audio.transcript: The accessibility consultant has recommended moving the main reception desk closer to the step-free entrance. The university has not yet approved the change, because electrical work would also be needed. The consultant will discuss a temporary desk with staff next week so that visitors can receive help while the permanent proposal is assessed.

audio.transcript: An urban planner argues that adding bus routes will have limited value if passengers cannot rely on the timetable. She recommends improving service reliability alongside network coverage, rather than treating the number of routes as the only measure of success.

analysis.exam_tip: 听 checking 后要求观察的两种行为。

audio.transcript: An education researcher warns that time spent on a learning app is not enough to show whether students have understood the material. She suggests checking what students can explain or apply after using it.

back_text: 时长不能充分说明理解程度，还应检查能否解释或运用所学。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 短路线若连接住宅和车站，可能比远离日常服务的长路线更有用。比较的关键是是否通向居民真正需要去的地方，不只是增加了多少公里。
analysis.exam_tip: 找 short route 后连接的两个目的地。

audio.transcript: A transport engineer says that a new cycle lane should connect useful destinations, not simply add distance to the network. A short route linking homes to a station may serve residents better than a longer route that ends far from everyday services.

back_text: 路线应连接日常需要到达的地点，长度不是唯一价值指标。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 数字资料即使全已上线，如果说明不清、搜索不好用，仍难查找。图书馆员因此要求 clear descriptions 和 a reliable search system，清楚说明与可靠检索。
analysis.exam_tip: 把“文件上线”和“能找到、能使用”区分开。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: a confident presentation 可能让证据薄弱的说法听起来可信。研究者建议检查 evidence and its source，即证据及其来源，不能只看说话人多自信。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 rather than 前建议采取的判断方法。

audio.transcript: A researcher studying online information cautions that a confident presentation can make a weak claim seem convincing. She advises readers to check the evidence and its source, rather than judging a statement only by how certain the speaker sounds.

back_text: 避免只凭表达自信就认定论点可靠，应核对证据和来源。

The trial should collect both staff feedback and information about service quality, since an arrangement that suits employees may still create problems for customers.

back_text: 先在一支团队试行，同时看员工反馈和服务质量，因为员工满意的安排也可能给客户带来问题。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 开头肯定草稿的想法和引言，但推荐收录前还有要求：核对两项数字主张的来源。Could you... 明确请求补上引用，并在明天发修订稿。

audio.transcript: There are several strong ideas in your draft, and the introduction is much clearer now. Before I can recommend it for the exhibition booklet, though, I need you to check the sources behind the two numerical claims. Could you add those references and send me a revised copy tomorrow?

Would tomorrow morning work for you? If you send the outline tonight, I can read it before we meet and make the conversation more useful.

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 做饭例子中，学生会照步骤做，却在缺一种食材时不会调整。说话人用它说明：实验学习也要理解每步为什么这样做，才能应对变化。

audio.transcript: Think of a student who can follow a recipe perfectly but becomes unsure when one ingredient is missing. Knowing the steps is useful, but understanding why each step matters makes adaptation possible. I mention this because the same distinction applies to laboratory work: a procedure should not be learned as an unexplained sequence of actions.

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 前面提出数量增加仍有困难，并转向组织方式。反问不是询问具体页面数，而是质疑既有解决方向。
analysis.exam_tip: 结合前文判断问题是在求事实，还是在挑战一种做法。

audio.transcript: We have doubled the number of online resources, yet students still report difficulty finding the right material. Perhaps the issue is not how much information we provide but how clearly we organise it. If adding more pages has not solved the problem, should our next step really be to add even more?

back_text: 引导听众重新考虑继续增加资源是否能解决查找困难。

analysis.summary: It might be worth trying... 是委婉建议。that format 指前句的每场报告后留一小段讨论时间，这样提前离开的人也有机会提问。

audio.transcript: The speakers were well prepared, and the topics attracted considerable interest. Still, several participants had to leave before they could ask questions. Other events reserve a short discussion period after each talk. It might be worth trying that format next time, instead of saving every question until the end of the day.

back_text: 考虑在每场报告后安排简短问答，不把所有问题留到一天结束。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: I’m not suggesting... 先说明不是要求放弃项目。My concern 才说真正担心的事：试点还未评估，就承诺效果；他希望继续研究时把收益说得谨慎些。

audio.transcript: I'm not suggesting that the project should be abandoned. My concern is that we are promising results before the pilot has been evaluated. We can continue the work while describing its benefits more cautiously. That would allow us to learn from the trial without giving participants expectations we may be unable to meet.

back_text: 澄清自己不是要求放弃项目，而是希望对预期效果更谨慎。

analysis.title: 解析

analysis.title: 解析

back_text: 示范比较与推理的方法，让学习者根据证据形成并修正自己的判断。

audio.transcript: The staff representatives accept that the old scheduling system needs to be replaced. They are encouraged by the prospect of fewer duplicated bookings, but they remain concerned about training and support during the changeover. Their position is not opposition to the new technology itself; they want the transition to be manageable for everyone using it.

back_text: 接受更换系统，也期待收益，但担心培训与过渡支持。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: promising 肯定早期结果，尤其等候时间减少。但说话人想先听使用困难者的反馈，再判断是否完全成功，因为平均改善可能掩盖部分人的问题。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 before 后还需要了解哪类用户。

audio.transcript: The early results are promising, particularly the reduction in waiting time. Nevertheless, I would hesitate to call the trial a complete success before we hear from users who found the system difficult. The average improvement is useful information, but it may conceal problems affecting a smaller group of participants.

back_text: 谨慎肯定，认为还需关注使用困难者，暂不能称完全成功。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: used to、began to question、now标记态度变化。说话人没有主张不做计划，而是改变了评价效率的标准。
analysis.exam_tip: 留意过去观点、转折经历和当前判断的时间标记。

audio.transcript: I used to believe that a full timetable was a sign of being productive. After several weeks of missing important deadlines, I began to question that assumption. Now I try to leave time between major tasks, and I judge a day by what I finish rather than by how crowded the calendar looks.

back_text: 从把忙碌当作高效，转为重视任务完成和安排余地。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 说话人认可方案背后的努力，但当前方案没交代网络受限的学生如何参加，因此不能支持。若补上合适的替代方式，方案仍可能有用。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 in its present form，反对的是当前方案缺少什么。

audio.transcript: I appreciate the effort behind the proposal, but the current version does not explain how students with limited internet access would participate. That omission needs to be addressed before implementation. With a suitable alternative for those students, the scheme could still be useful; in its present form, however, I cannot support it.

back_text: 不是全盘否定；当前因缺少替代参与方式而不支持，补足后仍可能有价值。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: It worries me 明确表达担忧：传闻被重复后，很快变成人们对某人的定论。说话人主张先核实发生了什么，再给当事人解释机会。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 should check 和 give...an opportunity 两项建议。

audio.transcript: It worries me how quickly a rumour can become a settled opinion about someone. Repeating a claim does not make it more reliable. Before judging a colleague, we should check what actually happened and give that person an opportunity to explain, especially when the original story is incomplete.

back_text: 持批评和担忧态度，主张核实事实并听取本人说明。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: cautiously optimistic 是谨慎乐观，因为最新会议更有建设性，双方同意交换数据。provided that 要求承诺接下来落实为行动，不能又停留在泛泛表态。
analysis.exam_tip: 把 cautiously optimistic 与后面的行动条件一起听。

audio.transcript: We have not resolved every disagreement, but the latest meeting was more constructive than the earlier ones. Both teams identified areas where they could work together and agreed to exchange data. I am cautiously optimistic, provided that those promises are followed by practical action rather than another round of general statements.

back_text: 有条件地乐观，前提是承诺转化为实际行动。

analysis.title: 解析

audio.transcript: The staff accept that the old equipment needs replacing. However, they remain doubtful about the promised training, because no timetable or budget has been announced. Their concern is about support during the change, not about keeping every old machine.

analysis.summary: 顾问欢迎弹性工时，但要先试行、再决定是否永久改变。试行须同时评估员工满意度和客户能否获得稳定、可预期的服务。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 both 回指的两项评估内容。

audio.transcript: The consultant welcomes flexible working hours but says they should be evaluated carefully. Staff satisfaction matters, she argues, yet customers also need predictable service. She would support a trial that measures both before a permanent change is made.

back_text: 支持试行弹性工时，并同时评估员工满意度和服务稳定性。

analysis.exam_tip: 用 Some...Others... 区分两类体验。

audio.transcript: Some workers welcome the freedom to choose individual assignments. Others worry that their income changes too sharply from month to month. The report presents both views and argues that flexibility alone does not describe the full experience of this type of work.

back_text: 因为选择任务的自由与收入波动的担忧都存在。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 工会原先支持现代化的条件是受影响工人获得合适培训。现在公司对培训交代太少，所以不能把对投资的支持理解为已认可整个转型安排。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 provided that 后的条件，再核对现在缺少什么。

audio.transcript: The union supported the plan to modernise the factory, provided that displaced workers received suitable training. It now says the company has offered too little detail about that training. Support for the investment therefore should not be mistaken for approval of every part of the transition.

back_text: 其支持以适当培训为条件，目前又认为培训细节不足。

analysis.title: 解析
analysis.summary: 经济学家认为有限价差可能促使供应商改进服务，前提是客户有真实替代选择。若一家控制整个市场，客户无处可选，这套解释就可能不成立。
analysis.exam_tip: 听 real alternatives，再对照 one supplier 的情形。

audio.transcript: The economist thinks a limited price difference can encourage suppliers to improve their services. However, she warns that customers must have real alternatives. If one supplier controls the entire market, the same argument may no longer apply.

audio.transcript: Previously, several groups sometimes reserved the same machine under different names. The new system links each reservation to a verified group account, preventing those duplicates. back_text: 验证小组账号防止重复预约，减少工作人员处理冲突的时间。

audio.transcript: The report arrived late on the same day that the office network failed. However, the author had completed and sent it before the failure. The delay occurred because the recipient's address had been entered incorrectly, and the message was not redirected until the next morning.

back_text: 收件地址填写错误，邮件到第二天才被转发。

analysis.summary: 额外检查本来为了减少错误，但没有说明何时需要做。员工几乎对所有申请都加查，连简单情况也查，直到办公室明确适用范围后才不再这样处理。

audio.transcript: The additional check was intended to reduce mistakes, but staff were not given clear instructions on when it was necessary.
